trade_network.coverage: All currently designated major production/processing/export nodes have inbound and outbound logistics in the first full network pass.

hard_constraints_preserved: All tree/wood families including Nether wood stay consolidated in Timberlands.
Bone meal belongs to Agriculture; Haunted Marches exports bones to Breadbasket for fertilizer integration.
Grand Exchange redistributes rather than centralizing source processing.
Nether and End production remain distinct where practical.
Production is integrated into settlements rather than replacing them.
